name: TC101 Precision Sensor
description: High-precision digital sensor for industrial automation applications. Features 16-bit resolution and I2C/SPI interface.
longDescription: The TC101 is a high-precision digital sensor designed for industrial automation. It offers 16-bit resolution with configurable I2C and SPI interfaces, making it suitable for a wide range of measurement and control applications.

seo.seoDescription: TC101 high-precision 16-bit digital sensor from _testdata. I2C/SPI interface, QFN-20 package. Industrial grade -40°C to +125°C.

faqs.question: What is the resolution of TC101?
faqs.answer: TC101 provides 16-bit resolution for high-precision measurements.

faqs.question: What interfaces does TC101 support?
faqs.answer: TC101 supports both I2C and SPI interfaces, configurable via pin selection.

name: TC102 Low-Noise Amplifier
description: Low-noise operational amplifier with 10MHz bandwidth and rail-to-rail output.
longDescription: The TC102 is a low-noise operational amplifier offering 10MHz bandwidth with rail-to-rail input and output. Ideal for precision signal conditioning in automotive and industrial applications.

seo.seoDescription: TC102 10MHz rail-to-rail low-noise op amp from _testdata. 2.7V-5.5V supply, 100µV offset. SOIC-8/MSOP-8 packages.

faqs.question: What is the bandwidth of TC102?
Is TC102 suitable for automotive?
faqs.answer: Yes, TC102 is qualified for automotive applications with AEC-Q100 certification.

name: TC103 ADC Converter
description: 12-bit successive approximation ADC with 1MSPS sampling rate and 8-channel multiplexer.
longDescription: The TC103 is a 12-bit successive approximation register (SAR) ADC with 1MSPS sampling rate. It features an 8-channel multiplexer, internal reference, and SPI interface for easy integration.

seo.seoDescription: TC103 12-bit SAR ADC from _testdata. 1MSPS, 8-channel, SPI interface. TSSOP-16 package. Order from authorized distributor.

name: TC104 Motor Controller
description: BLDC motor controller with FOC algorithm support, 48V/10A rated output.
longDescription: The TC104 is an advanced BLDC motor controller supporting field-oriented control (FOC). Rated for 48V/10A output with integrated gate drivers and protection features including over-current, over-temperature, and under-voltage lockout.

seo.seoDescription: TC104 BLDC motor controller from _testdata. 48V/10A, FOC support, integrated gate drivers. QFN-48 package. Distributor pricing available.
